summary: NewAmsterdam Pharma filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing the dosing of the first participant in SPINOZA, a Phase 2b trial of obicetrapib in preclinical Alzheimer's disease. The trial enrolls adults with biomarker evidence of preclinical Alzheimer's who lack noticeable memory or functional symptoms, evaluating blood-based markers including p-tau 217 plus cognitive and functional measures. No deal terms, stakes, prices, board recommendations, advisors, or regulatory clocks are disclosed; the filing is an ordinary product-development current report, not a special situation. Watch enrollment pace and any biomarker readout that could reprice NAMS shares beyond its core cardiovascular franchise.
